notes.title: Demo updated for Steam Next Festival
notes.notes:
Hello, Friends!

Spark of Joy the demo has been updated.

Based on feedback to the last version, we have adjusted some things, improved others, and added some new content. Also, we localized it in Chinese. Finally, the updated version of the demo is available now and during Steam Next Fest.

After you experience this latest update, we encourage you to share your thoughts. Whether it is stuff to improve or encouragement, detailed bug reports or technical guidance, or just long or short thoughts, we appreciate your input which helps us improve the quality of the final product.

Our goal is to regularly release more and better content that everyone likes to see and hear on the road to shipping the finished game. 

Wishing you all a happy Next Fest!

Cheers,
Big Chungus Productions

notes.title: The 12 days of Christmas in a special holiday image series
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays from Big Chungus Productions!

As you might or might not be aware, my partner began helping me with my games years ago, but only in 2024 started creating all the content (images, code, and writing) for my game, Horny Holiday. 

Now, they're creating Spark of Joy, and to celebrate the holiday season, we wanted to share a Christmas themed image set of the characters. The demo is coming along nicely, and should be ready in about a month from now, give or take a week.

Now, on to the images!
